# Urban VPN API wrapper

This repository includes a TypeScript module that connects to the Urban VPN API
and type definitions for each* endpoint.

\* each important endpoint

It provides a simple example of how to:

- Register an anonymous account
- Get a security token
- Retrieve a list of countries and their associated servers.

## Documentation

Run `deno doc --html *.ts` to generate documentation in the `docs/` directory.
Note that some package repositories (like JSR or the Deno repository)
have a feature to view the documentation generated by `deno doc` in the browser.

## Prerequisites

[this link]: https://docs.deno.com/runtime/getting_started/installation/#download-and-install

Before running the example, ensure that you have Deno installed.
You can download it from the [official website](https://deno.com/) via [this link].

## Examples

### Connecting

```ts
import {
	AccountService,
	ProxySignature,
	SecurityService,
	SignatureHelper,
	StaticProxiesService,
} from "@becauseyes/urbanvpn-api-wrapper";

const accountService = new AccountService();
const account = await accountService.registerAnonymous();
const accountToken = account.value;
const ss = new SecurityService();
const { value: securityToken } = await ss.getSecurityToken(accountToken);

const sps = new StaticProxiesService(securityToken);
const server = await sps.getAutoServer();
const sigs = SignatureHelper.calcSignatures(server);
const addr = server.address.primary;

const ps = ProxySignature.buildKey({
	scheme: "http",
	...addr,
});

const apt = await ss.getAuthProxyToken(securityToken, sigs[ps]);

const hc = Deno.createHttpClient({
	proxy: {
		url: `http://${addr.ip}:${addr.port}`,
		basicAuth: {
			username: apt.value,
			password: "1",
		},
	},
});

const r = await fetch(`https://proxycheck.io/v3/${addr.ip}`, {
	client: hc,
});

console.log(await r.json());
```

### All Servers in a Country

```ts
import {
	AccountService,
	SecurityService,
	StaticProxiesService,
} from "@becauseyes/urbanvpn-api-wrapper";

const accountService = new AccountService();
const account = await accountService.registerAnonymous();
const token = account.value;
const securityTokenWrap = await new SecurityService().getSecurityToken(token);
const securityToken = securityTokenWrap.value;
const countries = await new StaticProxiesService(securityToken).getCountries();
// I want a Brazil proxy
//! adjust "BR" to the ISO 2 code of a country (e.g. United States is "US", etc...)
const brazil = countries.elements.find((country) => country.code.iso2 === "BR");
if (!brazil) {
	// meme lol
	throw new Error("I guess we aren't going to Brazil today (couldn't find it)");
}
if (brazil.accessType === "INACCESSIBLE") {
	throw new Error("We can't access Brazil");
}
if (!brazil.servers.elements) throw new Error("No servers in Brazil lol");
// get some random server in the brazil.servers.elements array
// you could use the count variable in `brazil.servers`
// but it's just more safe to do this.
const servers = brazil.servers.elements.filter((server) =>
	server.accessType !== "INACCESSIBLE"
)
	.sort((a, b) => a.weight - b.weight); // sort by weight
const formattedServerData = (servers.filter((server) => server !== undefined)
	.map((server) => server.address)
	.map((addressesObj) => {
		let secondaryAddresses = addressesObj.secondary?.map((address) =>
			`${address.host}:${address.port}`
		);
		if (secondaryAddresses === undefined) secondaryAddresses = [];
		return [
			`${addressesObj.primary.host}:${addressesObj.primary.port}`,
			...secondaryAddresses,
		];
	})
	.flat()) as `${string}:${number}`[];

formattedServerData.forEach((server) => {
	console.log(server);
});
```

### Dump all servers in “host:port” format into a .txt file

```ts
import {
	AccountService,
	SecurityService,
	StaticProxiesService,
} from "@becauseyes/urbanvpn-api-wrapper";

const accountService = new AccountService();
const account = await accountService.registerAnonymous();
const token = account.value;
const securityTokenWrap = await new SecurityService().getSecurityToken(token);
const securityToken = securityTokenWrap.value;
const countries = await new StaticProxiesService(securityToken).getCountries();
const servers = (countries
	.elements
	.filter((country) => country.servers.elements !== undefined)
	.map((country) => country.servers.elements)
	.flat()
	.filter((server) => server !== undefined)
	.map((server) => server.address)
	.map((addressesObj) => {
		let secondaryAddresses = addressesObj.secondary?.map((address) =>
			`${address.host}:${address.port}`
		);
		if (secondaryAddresses === undefined) secondaryAddresses = [];
		return [
			`${addressesObj.primary.host}:${addressesObj.primary.port}`,
			...secondaryAddresses,
		];
	})
	.flat()) as `${string}:${number}`[];

await Deno.writeTextFile("./servers.txt", servers.join("\n"));
```

## First Server in Country

```ts
import {
	AccountService,
	SecurityService,
	StaticProxiesService,
} from "@becauseyes/urbanvpn-api-wrapper";

const accountService = new AccountService();
const account = await accountService.registerAnonymous();
const token = account.value;
const securityTokenWrap = await new SecurityService().getSecurityToken(token);
const securityToken = securityTokenWrap.value;
const countries = await new StaticProxiesService(securityToken).getCountries();
// I want a Brazil proxy
//! adjust "BR" to the ISO 2 code of a country (e.g. United States is "US", etc...)
const brazil = countries.elements.find((country) => country.code.iso2 === "BR");
if (!brazil) {
	// meme lol
	throw new Error("I guess we aren't going to Brazil today (couldn't find it)");
}
if (brazil.accessType === "INACCESSIBLE") {
	throw new Error("We can't access Brazil");
}
if (!brazil.servers.elements) throw new Error("No servers in Brazil lol");
// get some random server in the brazil.servers.elements array
// you could use the count variable in `brazil.servers`
// but it's just more safe to do this.
const servers = brazil.servers.elements.filter((server) =>
	server.accessType !== "INACCESSIBLE"
)
	.sort((a, b) => a.weight - b.weight); // sort by weight
console.log(servers, "(sorted by lowest to highest weight)");
const server = servers[0];
const { address } = server;
console.log("1st server (lowest weight):", server);
console.log(
	"...as Host:Port (primary)",
	`${address.primary.host}:${address.primary.port}`,
);
if (server.address.secondary) {
	server.address.secondary.forEach(
		(secondary, i) =>
			console.log(
				`...as Host:Port (secondary #${i + 1})`,
				`${secondary.host}:${secondary.port}`,
			),
	);
}
```
